name: Anchorpoint Cloud
tagline: Reliable cloud and hosting for the apps your business depends on.

copy.headline: Put your app somewhere reliable.
copy.lead: Tell us what you run and where it lives today. We'll look at hosting, backups, security and cost, and suggest a plan.
points: We work with what you already have.
copy.goalLabel: What do you run, and where?
copy.goalHint: The app, where it is hosted now, and what is not working.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Our app runs on a free tier and went down twice last month. We have no backups and no idea what it will cost as we grow.
copy.finePrint: No pitch, no pricing. Please don't share passwords, keys or customer data.
